13C-labeled all-trans lycopene reached 23.2 ± 8% bioavailability in healthy adults, showing that some lipophilic isoprenoids can exceed 20% under optimized labeled dosing conditions.
Hyperforin showed high oral bioavailability in volunteers, but its smaller prenylated phloroglucinol scaffold is structurally distant from the long-chain ubiquinone query.

evidence_gaps: No direct absolute oral bioavailability data for CoQ9 or CoQ10 are present in the evidence set.
Tocotrienol bioavailability is reported only qualitatively as poor, without a quantified F value.
Lycopene bioavailability varies strongly with formulation and food matrix, making intrinsic absorption estimates uncertain.
